actions_taken: Added a transparent local MCP observability proxy that forwards JSON-RPC to the seller and records redacted summaries plus raw-body hashes.
Routed idempotent replay through the proxy and captured three events with identical paid/replay response hashes.
Routed the P4 cold-restart child processes through the proxy and captured five events including three tasks/get polls.
Routed a full challenge-paid-poll-complete lifecycle through the proxy and captured four events.
Verified every trace marks paymentSemanticsDecoded=false and contains no raw bearer task ID, payer credential, or secret key.
Recorded the absence of an MCP paid-call semantic trace model in the append-only gap log.
key_results: Replay trace is legible enough to show challenge, paid success, and byte-identical replay at the MCP protocol level.
Cold-restart trace shows all buyer lifecycle traffic traversed the proxy, including authoritative tasks/get polling.
Full-lifecycle trace shows the expected tools/call, tools/call, tasks/get, tasks/get sequence.
The proxy observes payment-related JSON fields but has no notion of MPP, PaymentIntent semantics, receipt lifecycle, or paid-task correlation.

assumptions_made.assumption: A local transparent proxy is an adequate stand-in for an MCP Gateway for this evidence experiment.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: The event requires the hosted TrueForge MCP Gateway specifically, or its trace format is materially different from transparent HTTP forwarding.

assumptions_made.assumption: Raw-body hashes and redacted protocol summaries are sufficient evidence without publishing bearer task IDs.
assumptions_made.invalidation_condition: A reviewer requires byte-exact raw bodies and accepts the associated capability disclosure risk.

scope_creep_surfaced: TrueForge's optional MCP Gateway was not added because the direct local harness supplied no documented paid-call decoder; building one would exceed P5's observability measurement.
No hosted Postgres/Redis deployment or public gateway endpoint was used.
next_phase_readiness_reason: All three gateway traces are captured and the paid-observability absence is recorded. P6 can audit the extension, synthesize the upstream diff, and assemble vectors only after the literal token go.
